summary: Re-run of guardrails against rework commit 36f3ef09. Intent-review now reports spec_fidelity: pass -- both prior findings resolved via maintainer-approved AC narrowing recorded on gh issue #660: (1) AC2 skip_unchanged_head fully removed (output, env wiring, and every job gate) with an inline comment correctly attributing sibling base-rerun prevention to ADR-052's branch-protection change; (2) AC6 main_via_wave narrowed to the pull_request wave->main path only, with the dead merge_group branch (MERGE_GROUP_HEAD_REF compared against a synthetic gh-readonly-queue ref that never matches feature/*-wave) removed and the residual merge_group over-run explicitly deferred to follow-up #671. No new findings. Guardrails spot-checks unchanged from prior pass: gitleaks job carries no if: gate (unconditional across all tiers, verified by inspection); artifact-gate is fully deterministic (calls wave_manifest.py --check-artifacts only, no LLM invocation, gated tier=='main'); the require-code-and-secret-scanning gate treats skipped bandit/gitleaks as failure (skipped != passed is sound). resolve-issue and artifact-gate retain their own unrelated MERGE_GROUP_HEAD_REF usage for issue/wave-branch resolution -- confirmed a different job, different purpose, correctly untouched by this rework. No coverage hole introduced: direct-to-main PRs (main_via_wave defaults false) still run all four heavy jobs; wave->main pull_request still dedups correctly. 35/35 workflow contract + wave-manifest tests pass; actionlint clean.
